import numpy as np

# 1) Does my manual "type 5" formula match np.quantile(method='hazen')?
def type5_sorted(xs, p):
    n = len(xs)
    h = p * n + 0.5          # 1-based virtual index (Hazen)
    j = int(np.floor(h))
    g = h - j
    j0 = min(max(j, 1), n)   # 1-based
    if g == 0 or j0 >= n:
        return xs[j0-1]
    return xs[j0-1] + g * (xs[j0] - xs[j0-1])

        x = np.sort(rng.normal(size=n))
        a = np.quantile(x, p, method='hazen')
        b = type5_sorted(x, p)
        if not np.isclose(a, b, rtol=0, atol=1e-12*max(1,abs(a))):

# 2) Vectorized NaN-ignoring hazen quantile down columns, vs per-column dropna loop
def masked_hazen(V, p):
    # V: (m, ncells) with NaNs for missing; quantile ignoring NaN per column
    Vs = np.sort(V, axis=0)              # NaNs go to the end
    cnt = np.sum(np.isfinite(V), axis=0) # per-cell counts
    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
        h = p * cnt + 0.5                # 1-based virtual index
        j = np.floor(h).astype(np.int64)
        g = h - j
        jj = np.clip(j, 1, cnt)[None, :] - 1          # 0-based lower index
        out = np.take_along_axis(Vs, jj, axis=0)[0]
        upper_ok = (j + 1 <= cnt) & (g > 0)
        jj2 = np.clip(j + 1, 1, cnt)[None, :] - 1
        upper = np.take_along_axis(Vs, jj2, axis=0)[0]
        out = np.where(upper_ok, out + g * (upper - out), out)
    out = np.where(cnt > 0, out, np.nan)
    return out

rng = np.random.default_rng(7)

def masked_hazen(V, p):
    """Per-column hazen quantile of V (m, ncells), ignoring NaN. Matches np.quantile(method='hazen') per column."""
    Vs = np.sort(V, axis=0)
    cnt = np.sum(np.isfinite(V), axis=0)
    out = np.full(V.shape[1], np.nan)
    good = cnt >= 2
    c = cnt[good]
    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
        h = p * c + 0.5
        j = np.floor(h)
        g = h - j
        jj = np.clip(j, 1, c - 1).astype(np.int64) - 1  # 0-based lower of the segment, clamped to valid segment range
    lower = np.take_along_axis(Vs, jj[None, :], axis=0)[0]
    upper = np.take_along_axis(Vs, (jj + 1)[None, :], axis=0)[0]
    out[good] = lower + g * (upper - lower)
    single = (cnt == 1)

    diff_b_a = b - a

def masked_hazen(V, p):
    Vs = np.sort(V, axis=0); cnt = np.sum(np.isfinite(V), axis=0)
    out = np.full(V.shape[1], np.nan); good = cnt > 0
    if good.any():
        c = cnt[good].astype(np.float64); h = p*c + 0.5; j = np.floor(h); g = h - j
        lo = np.clip(j, 1, c).astype(np.int64) - 1; hi = np.clip(j+1, 1, c).astype(np.int64) - 1
        Vs_g = Vs[:, good]
